notes: Fixes Upload to QuickBooks XML parse error (-2147220480): SalesOrderAdd children are now emitted in the schema-required order (CustomerRef, TxnDate, RefNumber, TermsRef, DueDate, ShipMethodRef, Memo, lines) and TxnDate/DueDate are converted to YYYY-MM-DD. Empty optional fields are omitted instead of sent as empty elements. On upload failure the request XML is logged for diagnosis.
